data.description: Optional portable .adashi/storage.json, schemaVersion 1, closed backend enum sqlite/text/serverSql; serverSql uses connectionProfile and namespace. Missing descriptor means legacy SQLite. Optional generation UUID identifies a verified activation, scopes newly issued cursors and invalidates old handles. Missing data for an activated selection fails without seeding. Invalid/future/unavailable selections fail before initialization with no fallback; reads never materialize defaults. Project Settings uses the migration service to preview, verify and safely activate a selection shared by desktop and MCP; app settings contain registrations, not another backend choice.
data.name: Project Storage Descriptor
